subject: different cols in output (for two sets of files) but using same exact code

messages.author: 48ecc1e3de37e653
messages.subject: different cols in output (for two sets of files) but using same exact code
parts:
Hello, I am running the same exact code on two different sets of data files. 
The first set has 242 files and the second has 194 files. 
data0 and data1 are the part5_personsummary_MM_L40M100V400_T5A5 output data 

One has 214 cols and one has 212. The have 210 in common.
Please see below. 
Why does one have _wei and _pla suffixes while the other data set
does not have those. And visa versa with the "ACC_day_MVPA_bts_10_mg" "ACC_day_LIG_bts_10_mg"? 
Thanks !!!!!!!!!

> dim(data0)
[1] 242 214
> dim(data1)
[1] 194 212
> length(intersect(names(data0),names(data1)))
[1] 210
> setdiff(names(data0),names(data1))
[1] "ACC_day_MVPA_bts_10_mg_pla" "ACC_day_LIG_bts_10_mg_pla"  "ACC_day_MVPA_bts_10_mg_wei"
[4] "ACC_day_LIG_bts_10_mg_wei" 
> setdiff(names(data1),names(data0))
[1] "ACC_day_MVPA_bts_10_mg" "ACC_day_LIG_bts_10_mg"

messages.author: 017566be30afa7f3
messages.subject: Re: [GGIR] different cols in output (for two sets of files) but using same exact code
parts:
Hi ZT ZT,

I am not seeing this in my own test data.
Usually discrepancies between output files are caused by running different versions of GGIR. So, first verify this by re-running part 5 with overwrite=TRUE.

If that does not resolve the issue reinstall latest version of GGIR, restart RStudio, and reprocess a subsample of both datasets.

If this does not resolve please provide more detail:
- Is there a ACC_day_MVPA_bts_10_mg_pla, and ACC_day_MVPA_bts_10_mg_wei column?
- Which GGIR version are you using?

Thanks, Vincent
